label: CSS3
headline: CSS3 Cheat Sheet
description: Quick reference for CSS3 — selectors, box model, flexbox, grid, animations, variables, and more. Everything you need to style the web.

items.name: Universal
items.definition: Selects all elements on the page.

items.name: Type
items.definition: Selects all elements of the given HTML tag.

items.name: Class
items.definition: Selects all elements with the given class attribute.

items.name: ID
items.definition: Selects the element with the given ID attribute.

items.name: Group
items.definition: Selects all matching elements from a comma-separated list.

items.name: Chaining
items.definition: Selects elements that match both the type and the class.

items.name: Type + ID
items.definition: Selects an element that matches both the type and the ID.

items.name: Descendant
items.definition:
Selects all

elements anywhere inside a

.

items.name: Direct child
items.definition:
Selects

elements that are direct children of a

.

items.name: Adjacent sibling
items.definition:
Selects the first

element immediately after a

.

items.name: General sibling
items.definition:
Selects all

elements that are siblings after a

.

items.name: Has attribute
items.definition: Selects elements that have a target attribute, regardless of value.

items.name: Exact value
items.definition: Selects elements whose target attribute equals exactly "_blank".

items.name: Starts with
items.definition: Selects elements whose href starts with "/index".

items.name: Ends with
items.definition: Selects elements whose href ends with ".doc".

items.name: Contains
items.definition: Selects elements whose class contains the substring "chair".

items.name: Word match
items.definition: Selects elements whose title contains "chair" as a whole word.

items.name: Prefix
items.definition: Selects elements whose class is "chair" or starts with "chair-".

items.name: :link
items.definition: Selects unvisited links.

items.name: :visited
items.definition: Selects links the user has already visited.

items.name: :hover
items.definition: Selects an element when the user hovers over it.

items.name: :active
items.definition: Selects an element while it is being clicked or activated.

items.name: :focus
items.definition: Selects an element that currently has keyboard focus.

items.name: :not()
items.definition:
Selects every

that does not have the class "intro".

items.name: :root
items.definition: Selects the root element of the document — typically <html>.

items.name: :target
items.definition: Selects the element whose ID matches the URL fragment (#section).

items.name: :empty
items.definition: Selects elements that have no children (including text nodes).

items.name: :lang()
items.definition: Selects elements with a specific lang attribute value.

items.name: :first-child
items.definition:
Selects

elements that are the first child of their parent.

items.name: :last-child
items.definition:
Selects

elements that are the last child of their parent.

items.name: :nth-child()
items.definition: Selects the 2nd child element. Accepts numbers, keywords (odd/even), or expressions like 3n+1.

items.name: :nth-last-child()
items.definition: Same as :nth-child() but counts from the last child.

items.name: :first-of-type
items.definition:
Selects the first

sibling of its type within its parent.

items.name: :last-of-type
items.definition:
Selects the last

sibling of its type within its parent.

items.name: :nth-of-type()
items.definition: Selects the nth sibling of the same type within its parent.

items.name: :nth-last-of-type()
items.definition: Same as :nth-of-type() but counts from the last of that type.

items.name: :only-child
items.definition:
Selects

elements that are the only child of their parent.

items.name: :only-of-type
items.definition:
Selects

elements that are the only sibling of their type.

items.name: :checked
items.definition: Selects checked checkboxes or radio buttons.

items.name: :disabled
items.definition: Selects form elements that are disabled.

items.name: :enabled
items.definition: Selects form elements that are enabled (not disabled).

items.name: :required
items.definition: Selects input elements with the required attribute.

items.name: :optional
items.definition: Selects input elements without the required attribute.

items.name: :valid
items.definition: Selects input elements with a value that passes validation.

items.name: :invalid
items.definition: Selects input elements with a value that fails validation.

items.name: :in-range
items.definition: Selects inputs whose value is within the min/max range.

items.name: :out-of-range
items.definition: Selects inputs whose value is outside the min/max range.

items.name: :read-only
items.definition: Selects elements with the readonly attribute.

items.name: :read-write
items.definition: Selects elements that are editable (not readonly).

items.name: :indeterminate
items.definition: Selects checkboxes or radio buttons in an indeterminate state.

items.name: ::before
items.definition: Inserts generated content before the element's content.

items.name: ::after
items.definition: Inserts generated content after the element's content.

items.name: ::first-letter
items.definition: Selects the first letter of a block-level element.

items.name: ::first-line
items.definition: Selects the first line of a block-level element.

items.name: ::selection
items.definition: Styles the portion of text selected by the user.

items.name: ::placeholder
items.definition: Styles the placeholder text inside an input or textarea.

items.name: Named
items.definition: Use any CSS named color keyword (red, orange, rebeccapurple, etc.).

items.name: Hex
items.definition: 6-digit hex (#rrggbb) or 3-digit shorthand (#rgb).

items.name: Hex + alpha
items.definition: 8-digit hex (#rrggbbaa) — last two digits set opacity (00–FF).

items.name: rgb()
items.definition: Red, Green, Blue values from 0–255.

items.name: rgba()
items.definition: rgb() with an alpha channel from 0 (transparent) to 1 (opaque).

items.name: hsl()
items.definition: Hue (0–360 degrees), Saturation (%), Lightness (%).

items.name: hsla()
items.definition: hsl() with an alpha channel.

items.name: currentcolor
items.definition: Inherits the element's current color value.

items.name: transparent
items.definition: Fully transparent — shorthand for rgba(0,0,0,0).

items.name: Color
items.definition: Sets a solid background color.

items.name: Image
items.definition: Sets an image as the background.

items.name: Gradient
items.definition: Creates a linear color gradient as the background.

items.name: Radial gradient
items.definition: Creates a circular/elliptical color gradient.

items.name: Position
items.definition: Sets the starting position of the background image.

items.name: Size
items.definition: cover scales to fill the container; contain scales to fit without cropping.

items.name: Repeat
items.definition: Controls whether and how the background image tiles.

items.name: Attachment
items.definition: fixed keeps the image stationary while scrolling; scroll moves with the page.

items.name: Clip
items.definition: Defines how far the background extends: border-box, padding-box, or content-box.

items.name: Shorthand
items.definition: Combines color, image, position/size, repeat, and attachment in one declaration.

items.name: font-family
items.definition: Sets the typeface. List fallbacks separated by commas.

items.name: font-size
items.definition: Sets the size of the text. Accepts px, em, rem, %, vw, etc.

items.name: font-weight
items.definition: Sets text thickness: normal (400), bold (700), or a numeric value 100–900.

items.name: font-style
items.definition: Sets text style: normal, italic, or oblique.

items.name: line-height
items.definition: Sets the height of a line box. Unitless values (like 1.5) are relative to font-size.

items.name: letter-spacing
items.definition: Sets the space between characters.

items.name: word-spacing
items.definition: Sets the space between words.

items.name: text-align
items.definition: Aligns text horizontally: left, right, center, or justify.

items.name: text-decoration
items.definition: Adds a line to text: underline, overline, line-through, or none.

items.name: text-transform
items.definition: Changes text case: uppercase, lowercase, or capitalize.

items.name: text-indent
items.definition: Indents the first line of a text block.

items.name: white-space
items.definition: Controls how whitespace and line breaks are handled.

items.name: font shorthand
items.definition: Combines style, weight, size, line-height, and family in one declaration.

items.name: @font-face
items.definition: Loads a custom font from a file for use throughout the stylesheet.

items.name: width / height
items.definition: Sets the element's content area dimensions.

items.name: max-width
items.definition: Caps the element's width. Commonly used to make images responsive.

items.name: min-width
items.definition: Sets the minimum width below which the element won't shrink.

items.name: max-height / min-height
items.definition: Caps or floors the element's height.

items.name: padding
items.definition: Space inside the border. Shorthand: top/bottom left/right; or all four sides separately.

items.name: margin
items.definition: Space outside the border. margin: 0 auto centers a block element horizontally.

items.name: border
items.definition: Shorthand for border-width, border-style, and border-color.

items.name: border-radius
items.definition: Rounds the corners of an element's border box.

items.name: box-sizing
items.definition: border-box includes padding and border in the element's total width and height.

items.name: overflow
items.definition: Controls content that overflows: visible, hidden, scroll, or auto.

items.name: visibility
items.definition: Hides the element but it still occupies space (unlike display: none).

items.name: display
items.definition: Sets the display model: block, inline, inline-block, flex, grid, none, etc.

items.name: outline
items.definition: Like border but does not affect layout — often used for focus rings.

items.name: box-shadow
items.definition: Adds one or more shadow effects around the element's frame.

items.name: position: static
items.definition: Default — element follows normal document flow; top/left/etc. have no effect.

items.name: position: relative
items.definition: Offsets the element from its normal position without affecting surrounding elements.

items.name: position: absolute
items.definition: Removes element from flow; positioned relative to the nearest non-static ancestor.

items.name: position: fixed
items.definition: Like absolute but positioned relative to the viewport — stays put on scroll.

items.name: position: sticky
items.definition: Acts as relative until the element hits the given offset, then sticks like fixed.

items.name: z-index
items.definition: Controls stacking order of positioned elements. Higher value = in front.

items.name: top / right / bottom / left
items.definition: Offsets for positioned elements (non-static). Can use px, %, vw, etc.

items.name: Enable flex
items.definition: Creates a flex container; direct children become flex items.

items.name: flex-direction
items.definition: Sets the main axis: row (default), row-reverse, column, column-reverse.

items.name: flex-wrap
items.definition: nowrap (default) keeps all items on one line; wrap allows items to move to the next line.

items.name: justify-content
items.definition: Aligns items along the main axis: flex-start, center, flex-end, space-between, space-around, space-evenly.

items.name: align-items
items.definition: Aligns items along the cross axis: flex-start, flex-end, center, stretch, baseline.

items.name: align-content
items.definition: Aligns flex lines when there is extra space on the cross axis (only applies when wrapping).

items.name: gap
items.definition: Sets spacing between flex items (row-gap and column-gap in one declaration).

items.name: flex-flow
items.definition: Shorthand for flex-direction and flex-wrap.

items.name: flex-grow
items.definition: Defines how much an item grows relative to the others when extra space is available.

items.name: flex-shrink
items.definition: Defines how much an item shrinks relative to the others when space is tight.

items.name: flex-basis
items.definition: Sets the initial main size of the item before growing or shrinking.

items.name: flex shorthand
items.definition: Combines flex-grow, flex-shrink, and flex-basis. flex: 1 is shorthand for 1 1 0.

items.name: align-self
items.definition: Overrides align-items for a specific item.

items.name: order
items.definition: Changes the visual order of a flex item without altering the DOM. Lower = first.

items.name: Enable grid
items.definition: Creates a grid container; direct children become grid items.

items.name: grid-template-columns
items.definition: Defines the number and size of columns. fr = fraction of available space.

items.name: grid-template-rows
items.definition: Defines the number and size of rows.

items.name: grid-template-areas
items.definition: Names areas of the grid for use with grid-area on children.

items.name: gap
items.definition: Sets row and column gutters between grid cells.

items.name: justify-items
items.definition: Aligns all items along the inline (row) axis within their cells.

items.name: align-items
items.definition: Aligns all items along the block (column) axis within their cells.

items.name: justify-content
items.definition: Aligns the entire grid along the row axis when the grid is smaller than the container.

items.name: align-content
items.definition: Aligns the entire grid along the column axis when the grid is smaller than the container.

items.name: repeat()
items.definition: Shorthand to repeat a track definition a number of times.

items.name: minmax()
items.definition: Sets a minimum and maximum size for a track.

items.name: auto-fill / auto-fit
items.definition: auto-fill creates as many columns as fit; auto-fit collapses empty tracks.

items.name: grid-column
items.definition: Spans the item from column line 1 to column line 3 (occupies 2 columns).

items.name: grid-row
items.definition: Places the item starting at row 2 and spanning 2 rows.

items.name: grid-area
items.definition: Places the item into a named area defined by grid-template-areas.

items.name: grid-area (manual)
items.definition: Shorthand for grid-row-start / grid-column-start / grid-row-end / grid-column-end.

items.name: justify-self
items.definition: Overrides justify-items for a single item along the row axis.

items.name: align-self
items.definition: Overrides align-items for a single item along the column axis.

items.name: transition
items.definition: Shorthand for transition-property, duration, timing-function, and delay.

items.name: transition-property
items.definition: Specifies which CSS properties to animate. Use 'all' or a comma-separated list.

items.name: transition-duration
items.definition: How long the transition takes to complete.

items.name: transition-timing-function
items.definition: The acceleration curve: ease, linear, ease-in, ease-out, ease-in-out, cubic-bezier().

items.name: transition-delay
items.definition: How long to wait before the transition starts.

items.name: @keyframes
items.syntax: @keyframes slide-in { from { transform: translateX(-100%); } to { transform: translateX(0); } }
items.definition: Defines the animation sequence using from/to or percentage-based keyframes.

items.name: animation-name
items.definition: Specifies the name of the @keyframes animation to apply.

items.name: animation-duration
items.definition: Sets how long one cycle of the animation takes.

items.name: animation-timing-function
items.definition: The acceleration curve for the animation: ease, linear, ease-in, ease-out, ease-in-out.

items.name: animation-delay
items.definition: How long to wait before the animation starts.

items.name: animation-iteration-count
items.definition: How many times the animation repeats. Use a number or 'infinite'.

items.name: animation-direction
items.definition: normal, reverse, alternate, or alternate-reverse — controls playback direction.

items.name: animation-fill-mode
items.definition: forwards keeps the end state after the animation; backwards applies the start state before it begins.

items.name: animation-play-state
items.definition: running or paused — toggle to start/stop the animation via JavaScript.

items.name: animation shorthand
items.definition: Combines name, duration, timing-function, delay, iteration-count, direction, and fill-mode.

items.name: translate
items.definition: Moves the element by X and Y without affecting document flow.

items.name: translateX / Y
items.definition: Moves the element along a single axis. -50% is commonly used for centering.

items.name: scale
items.definition: Scales the element up or down. scale(1.2) = 120% of original size.

items.name: rotate
items.definition: Rotates the element clockwise by the given angle.

items.name: skew
items.definition: Skews the element along the X and Y axes.

items.name: transform-origin
items.definition: Sets the pivot point for transforms. Default is center center.

items.name: Multiple transforms
items.definition: Apply multiple transforms in a single declaration — they are applied right to left.

items.name: Define variable
items.definition: Declares a custom property at :root so it's globally accessible.

items.name: Use variable
items.definition: Reads the value of a custom property with var().

items.name: With fallback
items.definition: The second argument to var() is a fallback if the variable is undefined.

items.name: Local scope
items.definition: Variables can be scoped to any selector — they cascade like other properties.

items.name: Update via JS
items.definition: Custom properties can be read and updated at runtime with JavaScript.

items.name: Media query
items.definition: Applies styles only when the viewport is 768px wide or narrower.

items.name: Min-width
items.definition: Applies styles when the viewport is at least 1024px wide (desktop-first approach).

items.name: Orientation
items.definition: Targets devices in landscape (wider than tall) orientation.

items.name: Dark mode
items.definition: Applies styles when the OS is set to dark mode.

items.name: Reduced motion
items.definition: Disables or simplifies animations for users who prefer less motion.

items.name: Print
items.definition: Applies styles only when the page is being printed.

items.name: Viewport units
items.definition: vw = 1% of viewport width; vh = 1% of viewport height.

items.name: opacity
items.definition: Sets transparency of the element and its children from 0 (invisible) to 1 (fully visible).

items.name: cursor
items.definition: Changes the mouse cursor style: pointer, default, move, not-allowed, copy, etc.

items.name: pointer-events
items.definition: none makes the element transparent to mouse/touch events.

items.name: user-select
items.definition: Controls whether text can be selected: none, text, all, auto.

items.name: scroll-behavior
items.definition: Enables smooth animated scrolling when navigating to anchor links.

items.name: object-fit
items.definition: How replaced elements (img, video) fill their container: cover, contain, fill, none, scale-down.

items.name: aspect-ratio
items.definition: Maintains a fixed width-to-height ratio as the element resizes.

items.name: clip-path
items.definition: Clips an element to a shape: circle, ellipse, polygon, or inset.

items.name: filter
items.definition: Applies visual filters: blur, brightness, contrast, grayscale, sepia, drop-shadow, etc.

items.name: !important
items.definition: Overrides any other declaration for this property regardless of specificity. Use sparingly.
